# A problem statement with no gaps these rules find

**Technology stack:** Go and PostgreSQL.

The report must finish within 2 seconds, fast enough for 95 of 100 users.

## Success

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|---|---|---|
| Lead time | half the baseline | Time from the first task to acceptance. |

The start of the pilot is in May. The PSB names the API.

|---|---|
| **PSB** | Problem Statement Brief. |
